Name: Shimei, Son of Gershon
Summary: Gershonite named among the sons of Levi in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:7: Gershonite named among the sons of Levi in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shimei in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
